run_motion_prediction_training: run the motion prediction training script with a preprocessed dataset path and model save path
train_seq2seq_model: train a seq2seq motion prediction model using LSTM or transformer architecture with teacher forcing
plot_training_curves: plot and save training and validation loss curves as an SVG file after training
set_random_seeds: set deterministic random seeds for PyTorch, NumPy, and Python random modules for reproducibility
evaluate_model_with_mae: evaluate a trained motion prediction model on validation data and log the mean absolute error
